attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) to act as an L3 router between node2 and node3 over a previously-unaddressed transit network (eth1↔enp8s0 to node2 at 192.168.12.0/24, eth2↔enp8s0 to node3 at 192.168.13.0/24), enabled IP forwarding, and applied an nftables forward-chain ACL that rejects (TCP RST) forwarded TCP/23 while explicitly allowing TCP/8080 and leaving all other forwarded traffic (e.g. ICMP) untouched by default-accept. All config was made persistent (network interfaces.d drop-in, sysctl.d, and a systemd transit-acl.service that reapplies the nft table and interface addresses at boot). Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3, confirming a changed boot_id and full functional recovery (ACL behavior, addressing, routing) after each restart.
